# `data/` — built output (layer 3). Do not edit.

Everything here except this file and `index.js` is generated by `npm run make:all`
from `csvs/` (authored) and `derived/` (script-written) and is **gitignored**.
Edit a CSV → `npm test` → `npm run make:all` → this directory updates. See
[`../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

Hand-curated history panels are **not** here; they live in `../panels/`.

## Layout

| Path | Node type | Source | Loader in `index.js` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `polity/<id>.json` | Polity | `csvs/polity.csv` + `polity_territory.csv` + `figure.csv` | `loadDir` |
| `succession/all.json` | Succession edge | `derived/polity_succession.csv` | `loadDir` |
| `territory/<id>.json` | Territory | `csvs/territory.csv` + `polity_territory.csv` | `loadDir` |
| `dynasty/<id>.json` | Dynasty | `csvs/dynasty.csv` + `polity_dynasty.csv` | `loadDir` |
| `government/<id>.json` | Government form | `csvs/government.csv` | `loadDir` |
| `ethnicity/` (tree) | Ethnicity | `csvs/ethnicity.csv` | `loadTree` |
| `language/` (tree) | Language | `csvs/language.csv` | `loadTree` |
| `religion/` (tree) | Religion | `csvs/religion.csv` | `loadTree` |

## File formats

### Polity — `polity/<id>.json`

```json
{
  "id": "kushan_empire",
  "name": "Kushan Empire",
  "ruling_ethnicity": "central_asian_steppe_bloc",
  "cultural_language": "bactrian",
  "ideology": { "religion": "buddhism", "government": "imperial_monarchy" },
  "territories": ["transoxiana", "khorasan", "punjab", "indus_valley"],
  "start": 30,
  "end": 375,
  "note": "…",
  "figures": [ { "id": "kanishka", "name": "Kanishka I", "role": "ruler" } ]
}
```

`territories[]` is derived from the junction table (ordered by first control
year). Cross-references are string ids into the other entity sets. Years are
integers; BCE negative; `end: null` = ongoing.

### Succession — `succession/all.json`

Flat array of directed, computed edges:

```json
{
  "from": "roman_republic", "to": "roman_empire",
  "territorial_direction": "same", "strength": 18,
  "shared_territories": ["italia", "gallia"], "shared_territory_count": 2,
  "same_ethnicity": true, "related_ethnicity": false,
  "same_language": true, "same_religion": false,
  "temporal_gap_years": 0
}
```

### Territory — `territory/<id>.json`

```json
{ "id": "egypt", "name": "Egypt", "polity_count": 12,
  "polities": [ { "polity_id": "old_kingdom_egypt", "start_year": -2686, "end_year": -2181 } ] }
```

### Dynasty — `dynasty/<id>.json`

```json
{ "id": "house_of_habsburg", "name": "House of Habsburg", "ethnicity": "german",
  "polities": [ { "polity_id": "holy_roman_empire", "start": 1438, "end": 1806 } ] }
```

### Taxonomy node — `ethnicity/` · `language/` · `religion/`

One JSON file per node inside a directory tree; a node with children is
`<id>/index.json`, a leaf is `<parent-path>/<id>.json`. `parent` is re-derived
from the path by the loader, so the tree shape equals the CSV's `parent_id` graph.

## Loader — `index.js`

- `loadDir(dir)` — flat recursive load into an array; strips `//` comments.
- `loadTree(dir)` — taxonomy load; derives `parent` from directory structure and
  exposes `db.tree.<type>(id)` for descendant queries.

`server.js` requires this module once at start-up and serves it read-only.
